🔍 Worldcoin ( $WLD) scans the horizon as the AI-proof identity oracle, verifying humanity while regulatory storms brew and institutions stack sats.

Current Price & Performance
$WLD trading at $0.635, up +4.32% in 24h vs BTC -0.5% & ETH -0.3%.
24h volume $136.2M rebounding liquidity in identity niche. Price consolidating $0.61 – $0.66 range, accumulation amid volatility.

Recent Highlights
• Eightco Holdings treasury bet Nov 18: Nasdaq-listed firm allocates $155M (10% of circ supply) to WLD, launching enterprise World ID authentication for AI-driven verification.
• Global regulatory pushback intensifies Nov 22: Colombia mandates data deletion and ops halt, following Philippines/Thailand bans erasing 14% but sparking privacy upgrades.
• World Chain TVL surges +$50M post-CCTP V2 integration: Seamless USDC transfers across ETH/Solana unlock DeFi liquidity, with 12M verified users claiming grants.

Technical Indicators
RSI 4h ~39 → neutral from oversold (prior 29), bullish divergence hinting rebound without exhaustion.
Price above 100-hourly SMA ($0.62); MACD flattening for momentum shift.
On-chain: Large wallets accumulating 10%+ holdings, exchange balances down 15% in 24h.

Ecosystem Role
$1.49B market cap. Utility token for biometric ID network: World ID verifies 12M+ humans via Orb scans, powering governance, UBI grants, and Sybil-resistant dApps on Optimism L2.
75% supply to community; integrates with Uniswap/Reddit for bot-proof voting, capturing $10T+ global identity market.

Outlook
Weekly unlocks (37M WLD) add pressure, but Eightco validation + privacy code upgrades eye $1.88 highs by EOY 2025. Oversold setup primed for reversal.
Break above $0.66 → targets $0.68–$0.75 (7-18% rally).
Key support $0.61–$0.57 hold to avoid $0.54 downside.
$WLD doesn't fear AI takeover it proves we're human. Sub-$0.65? The dip before iris scans unlock $2+ in 2026. 
@EdgenTech #WLD #Worldcoin
